svg.title: The Doors of New Rome: proposed interior work network
svg.desc: 400-square geographic study. Fictional sites and walking connections, modern generalized shore control and surface samples. No ancient footprint, navigation or gameplay approval. White is unclassified; generalized coast omits the GoldenHorn inlet.

g.text: The Doors of New Rome — world-plan study
Constantinople 380 · gpt-6 · 24 October 2026 · design-only; full dossier still pending
N ↑ E → · 400 × 400 · fictional activity sites · blue: current OSM coast; gray: Natural Earth; neither is an ancient coast
White is unclassified. Detailed current OSM lines resolve the inlet; no ancient coastline is inferred.
Nominal centerlines, not pathfinding or completion time.
Recipient movement is separate and still needs full planning.
Heights include modern surface objects; not year-380 ground.
No Theodosian413wall, later church fabric or modern bridge.
No actor is placed on a named historical church parcel.
All circles and corridor widths require native footprint QA.
Coast: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL1.0 (openstreetmap.org/copyright); Natural Earth, public domain. DSM: Copernicus research crop.
